title: A dialog created with keyboard: false must stay open however often Escape is pressed
status: Open and labelled confirmed. A maintainer-side fix is proposed in pull request #43077, not merged at pinnedCommit. That pull request is never sent to the model; it is kept for comparison after it merges.
summary: keyboard: false only calls preventDefault() on the native cancel event. Escape does not count as user activation, so after a few presses Chromium fires cancel with cancelable=false and the dialog closes anyway.
dependencies: dist/css/bootstrap.min.css: the published 6.0.0-alpha.1 stylesheet from npm (MIT); the repository does not commit built CSS
consumer: Author-written payment confirmation page around the unchanged TypeScript source at pinnedCommit, served with types erased by Node's built-in stripping. The page turns off the dialog transition and moves focus on shown.bs.dialog, so that the separate initial-focus issue #43120 does not affect this task.
